equations.equation_text: S is M-complete iff S proves Q_existence and S proves Q_intelligibility and S proves Q_meaning

mappings.notes: M-Completeness condition is the formal requirement that the three metaphysical questions impose on any candidate system.
Elimination funnel shows the 7Q classifier reducing 60 worldviews to 1, with 46/47 eliminations verified by SMT solvers.
The God Story constraint 'Aloneness => creation motivated by love, not need' maps to axiom AX-001 in the spine.
The God Story constraint 'Goodness => freedom must be real' maps to axiom AX-002 in the spine.
The God Story constraint 'Freedom => refusal must be possible' maps to axiom AX-003 in the spine.
The God Story constraint 'Cost => entropy/sin enters as price of freedom' maps to axiom AX-004 in the spine.
The God Story constraint 'Cost => entropy/sin enters as price of freedom' also maps to axiom AX-005 in the spine.
The God Story constraint 'Cost => entropy/sin enters as price of freedom' also maps to axiom AX-006 in the spine.
The claim that the three metaphysical questions are requirements, not decorations, is the central thesis of the page.
The claim that the 7Q classifier is injective on well-defined worldviews is stated explicitly.
The claim that the surviving worldview satisfies specific properties (external source, personal reality, etc.) is the result of the elimination funnel.
The claim that the 47th elimination is under manual review is flagged as pending verification.

page_record.notes: Page introduces the three metaphysical questions as formal requirements, the 7Q Universal Classifier, and the God Story as a requirements-extraction device. Mappings to axioms AX-001 through AX-006 are referenced but not defined on this page.
